description: Implement a consistent navigation authorization pattern across all UI components where role-restricted items appear. Instead of hiding restricted items, display them as disabled with explanatory tooltips to prevent flickering and improve transparency. Additionally, create a shared billing redirect helper that works correctly for both Cloud and Self-Hosted deployments.
functional_requirements: Display role-restricted navigation items (settings tabs, breadcrumbs, sidebar links) as visibly disabled with explanatory hover messages instead of hiding them
Apply the same disabled-state pattern consistently across organization/project breadcrumb menus and main sidebar links
Create a shared billing redirect helper that routes to '/settings/billing' for Cloud and '/settings/enterprise' for Self-Hosted deployments
Update all affected navigation redirects to use the new shared billing helper
Ensure the implementation eliminates flickering behavior during authorization checks
Add comprehensive tests for the new navigation authorization behavior and billing redirect logic
